name: Second Spanish Republic

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, yellow and purple, with the coat of arms of the Republic in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Purple was added to the red and yellow of the old Spanish flag to represent Castile, whose banner was then believed to have been purple.

hook: The Second Spanish Republic swapped the bottom red stripe of Spain's flag for purple, and made the three stripes equal: red, yellow, purple.
trivia: The Republic ended in 1939 with Francisco Franco's victory in the Spanish Civil War.
The tricolour is still flown at demonstrations by Spaniards who favour abolishing the monarchy.
